passive.name: The Plum Fragrance In My Bones
passive.text:
Increases the wearer's Break Effect by **60/70/80/90/100%**. When the wearer uses their Ultimate, increases all allies' DMG by **24/28/32/36/40%**, lasting for **3** turn(s). If the wearer's Break Effect exceeds or equals **150%**, 1 Skill Point will be recovered.
At the start of each wave, all allies regenerate **10/12.5/15/17.5/20** Energy immediately. Abilities of the same type cannot stack.

passive.name: Cannot Stop It!
passive.text: When the wearer uses their Ultimate, all allies' actions are Advanced Forward by **16/18/20/22/24%**.

passive.name: Flustered
passive.text: After entering combat, increases all allies' Break DMG dealt by **16/18/20/22/24%**. Abilities of the same type cannot stack.

passive.name: Old Photo
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by **28/35/42/49/56%**. When the wearer attacks, additionally regenerates **4/5/6/7/8** Energy. This effect cannot be repeatedly triggered in a single turn.

passive.name: Fleet Triumph
passive.text: After the wearer uses attacks or gets hit, additionally regenerates **4/5/6/7/8** Energy. This effect cannot be repeatedly triggered in a single turn.

tracePriority: Dance With the One (A2) > Hat of the Theater (A6) > Shuffle Along (A4)

entries.name: Swing Dance Etiquette
entries.text: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to **100%** of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy target.

entries.name: Halftime to Make It Rain
entries.text: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to **50%** of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy target and additionally deals DMG for 4 times, with each time dealing Imaginary DMG equal to **50%** of the Trailblazer's ATK to a random enemy.

entries.name: All-Out Footlight Parade
entries.text: Grants all allies the Backup Dancer effect, lasting for **3** turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of Trailblazer's every turn. Allies with the Backup Dancer effect have their Break Effect increased by **30%**. And when they attack enemy targets that are in the Weakness Broken state, the Toughness Reduction of the attack will be converted into 1 instance of Super Break DMG.

entries.name: Full-on Aerial Dance
entries.text: The Trailblazer immediately regenerates **10** Energy when an enemy target's Weakness is Broken.

entries.name: Now! I'm the Band!
entries.text: After the Technique is used, at the start of the next battle, all allies' Break Effect increases by **30%**, lasting for **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Dance With the One
entries.text: When the number of enemy targets on the field is (≥5)/4/3/2/1, the Super Break DMG triggered by the Backup Dancer effect increases by **20%**/**30%**/**40%**/**50%**/**60%**.

entries.name: Shuffle Along
entries.text: When using Skill, additionally increases the Toughness Reduction of the first instance of DMG by **100%**.

entries.name: Hat of the Theater
entries.text: After ally targets break weakness, additionally delays the action of the enemy target by **30%**.

entries.name: Best Seat in the House
entries.text: After using Skill for the first time, immediately recovers 1 Skill Point(s).

entries.name: Jailbreaking Rainbowwalk
entries.text: When the battle starts, the Trailblazer's Energy Regeneration Rate increases by 25%, lasting for 3 turn(s).

entries.name: Sanatorium for Rest Notes
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Dove in Tophat
entries.text: While the Trailblazer is on the field, increases the Break Effect of all teammates (excluding the Trailblazer), by an amount equal to 15% of the Trailblazer's Break Effect.

entries.name: Poem Favors Rhythms of Old
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Tomorrow, Rest in Spotlight
entries.text: The number of additional DMG applications by the Skill increases by 2.
